what are the fields in op service billing form

The fields in the OP service billing form include: 1. File Type: Specifies whether the file type is OP, IP, New, or Outsider. 2. Category: Specifies the category of the patient (e.g., Cash, Insurance, Corporate). 3. Service: Specifies whether the billing is for 'Consultation' or 'Services'. 4. File No: Used to enter the file number of the patient. 5. ID#: Displays the document value of the patient. 6. Elig. Discovery: A button to check the eligibility of the patient for billing services under insurance. 7. Scheme: Specifies the scheme name for billing the service under insurance. 8. Estimate No: Used to enter the estimate number. 9. Document Value: Used to enter the document value of the patient. 10. Mobile: Used to enter the mobile number of the patient. 11. Status: Used to filter the appointments based on status.

how to switch from cr to ca for insurance aptients

To switch from credit (CR) to cash (CA) for insurance patients, you need to follow these steps:

1. Upon entering the patient file number, all services ordered by the doctor will automatically populate on the screen.
2. If any service requires approval, its status will be indicated.
3. There will be an option to switch from credit (CR) to cash (CA) for insurance patients.

This process allows you to change the billing method for the services associated with the patient.
